title: quassia glauca
intro: Quassia glauca, commonly known as Quassia, is a tropical plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of dyspepsia. The therapeutic actions of Quassia glauca include its antiseptic, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against infections, fight off viral infections, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Quassia glauca include quassin, limonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
